notes.title: The journey continues - chapter 2 is now underway! 🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! We're immensely thankful for all the feedback and suggestions you've shared with us - we've read through every review and took all the feedback into account. We're asking for your opinion now - help us decide! 

Would you prefer a sequel that continues the current story or a prequel that explores what happened before? Please, let us know what feels right for you and what you'd like to see - share your thoughts either here or put your vote in a poll on our Discord server.

[b]It's up to you to decide what it will be about - we're eager to see what you pick![/b][/h3]

notes.title: By order of the Queen, the realm shall be made stable once more! 🔨
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, dear players![/h2]

We're glad to announce that the patch fixing existing technical issues, even rather rare ones, is out!

[h3]Here's a summary of the fixed problems:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The general performance of the game has been vastly improved, including lower-end machines. The updated system 

New requirements are:
ОS: Windows 10/11
CPU: Intel Core i3 2.4GHz or similar AMD one
RAM: 4 GB
GPU: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or similar AMD one
Disk space: 6.6 GB 

[*] The size of the game has been reduced
[*] Improved widescreen compatibility - now everyone can enjoy the game regardless of the aspect ratio
[*] Certain narrative fixes - for example, Lord Ironhad seemed to be really horny even after the rescue 😉
[*] Sound stuttering in animated scenes
[/list]


If you're still facing any problems - please let us know. The best way is to reach out through our Discord server - simply open a support ticket there, and we'll be with you shortly!

We're sorry for any inconvenience caused by the previously existing issues - there are endless combinations of software and hardware making finding out about every possible problem in advance nearly impossible. 

Thanks everyone for letting us know and giving feedback!

[h3]We'll be eagerly waiting to see you back in game again! 💘[/h3]

notes.title: ❗️ Important announcement regarding Chinese translation ❗️
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We'd like to acknowledge that we looked at the feedback on the Chinese translation, and, unfortunately, it turns out that the contractor we hired for this didn't do the best job, and we're currently in the process of remaking the translation to provide our Chinese fans with a better experience. If you'd like to participate in the translation process, feel free to reach out  through our Discord server. We'll also fix a few minor bugs we found alongside the language patch.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and letting us know what to improve! You're helping us to make games better.

With warm regards, Taboo Tales 💘

notes.title: The community is growing bigger - our Discord server is on the way! 🎉
notes.notes:
April 26 will bring us all together in the new place - we're getting our Discord server ready! As the Sex of Thrones 👑 Prologue comes out - we'll open the doors of the newly launched server for everyone to gather and communicate.
"Why does it matter?" - may you ask. For a lot of reasons actually, let us elaborate:
— Cozy and convenient place to talk about our games, your experiences with them and just whatever you want besides that.
— Faster reach out to the developers - when you'll have any questions or suggestions we'll see them and reply much faster.
— Bug reporting and support - there will be fast and handy way to do that, making it easier both for us and you to deal with any
possible issue.
— Safe environment to discuss your interests and pastimes - privacy, no judgment and like-minded people are awaiting.
— More news about development, events to interact with developers and much more!

We're eagerly looking forward to meeting all of you there! 🔜

notes.title: We’re glad to announce that Sex of Thrones 👑 is on the doorstep!
notes.notes:
A throne awaits - spring brings rejuvenation, new life and new games - at the start of June our game will finally be out. Thanks for all your patience and help - we were working our minds off to bring you the most unusual medieval fantasy you could dream of! 🏰
Right now we are polishing the graphics, looking for bugs and making sure everything is just alright. A little bit more waiting time, and you can immerse yourself in a world full of epic history, intrigues, dragons and sexy princesses! Would you help one of them retrieve the throne she thinks is rightfully hers or just look for your own self-interest? Get to know at the end of the spring! 🔜

Thanks for still being with us, gamers. We appreciate you and your attention!

notes.title: Meet the characters of "SEX OF THRONES"
notes.notes:
Hello! 

Let me tell you the story of Adolia, the mysterious maid at Ironhide Castle. With her appearance defined by her Darkfellows-like graceful face and mysterious eyes, she carries the mark of royalty. The daughter of a deceased castellan who was secretly dismissed from his duties, she seems condemned to the role of a servant.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/2dda2f56ea13066b801b2fb4ffc7ca77df4ed506.jpg[/img]
However, behind her graceful appearance lies the pride of a royal bastard. Adolia dreams of a great kingdom, not the walls of the castle she grew up in. In this castle world, where many intrigues are at play, Adolia has indeed accidentally fallen into a maze of conspiracies and desires. Her secret love for Lawrence, who has long regarded her as only a childhood friend, has become for her a light that shows the way in the darkness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/812c6f6d24ec60eea8ba78de1f0cf9d3531fd447.jpg[/img]
Thus, she weaves together the mystery of a royal inheritance and the pride of an unrecognized lover, ready to intertwine the fate of her famous family with the duties of a servant.

notes.title: Important Update Regarding Game Release 🚀
notes.notes:
Hello, our incredible gaming community!

We want to share important information with you regarding the release of our game. Our team has been working on this project with immense enthusiasm and dedication, and we want every aspect of the game to meet your expectations.

In the past week, we identified several opportunities for improvement and additional tuning that, in our opinion, will add even more emotion and joy to your gameplay. Therefore, we have made the important decision to slightly delay the release of the game.

We understand that this may be disappointing for many of you, and we apologize for any inconvenience. However, we are confident that these changes will allow us to provide you with the best gameplay and unforgettable experiences.

We are very grateful for your patience and support. Our goal is to create a game that you will love, and we are doing everything possible to make it the best.

Stay with us; we promise it will be worth the wait!

With love,
The SEX OF THRONES 👑 Team 💫🎮

notes.title: Meet the characters of "SEX OF THRONES"
notes.notes:
Lawrence Ironhead is an extremely calm, quiet, and intelligent man. His character is marked by tolerance and wisdom. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/d62fb9adf41369d843c6d8d60d8c5a54456dba0d.jpg[/img]
Lawrence is not at all shy in his boundless intellect, and he often immerses himself in books from his vast library, explores new ideas, and invents great innovations for his house and the kingdom as a whole. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/d829a5f7f3c614b777edf781f17919a551b7982b.jpg[/img]
He is not just a ruler; he is a true model of morality and moral principles. Even in matters of the heart, Lawrence Ironhead chooses with his mind and senses. He is engaged to a charming noble girl.

notes.title: Meet the characters of "SEX OF THRONES"
notes.notes:
And while you are enjoying the demo version of our game, we want to continue to get acquainted with the characters of our novel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/77654dee71df0389dea6bfdb42c552400444696a.jpg[/img]
Jeanna V'Ait, the embodiment of chivalry and guardian of virtue. In her dark hair and black eyes, not only her strength but also the determination to follow the path of honor is reflected. In her heart, the flame of loyalty to Liliana burns, the princess for whom she is not just a bodyguard but an integral part of the uprising. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44359290/f62327ca87092ceaabeba6e90bbaa45f2ee566e2.jpg[/img]
A darling of the people, Jeanna recreates the image of a knight in all its glory—brave, steadfast, and merciless to enemies. Her sword is a symbol of honor and justice, and she is ready to go through fire and water to defend her kingdom and the cherished Liliana.

notes.title: News about SEX OF THRONES 👑
notes.notes:
Hello, adventure seekers! 🚀

We are excited to introduce to you another long-awaited update from the gaming world! Welcome to the world of "Sex of Thrones" - the hottest visual novel for adults that is already in active development! 🎮🔥

What awaits you:

🎮 Mini-Game: Get ready for thrilling challenges and test your skills in games that reveal new dimensions of entertainment.

🌆 Animated Locations: Immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere of "Sex of Thrones" thanks to detailed and dynamic locations that will truly captivate you.

🔎 Quest System: Puzzles, riddles, and tasks await you, requiring your intellect and determination. Guide your character through a richly woven adventure!

🃏 Adult Cards: The game's storyline leads to various developments, and your choices will impact which hot cards are unlocked for you. You play, you choose, you indulge!

"Sex of Thrones" promises to be the hottest and most exciting game of its genre, and we can't wait for you to experience it firsthand. Stay tuned for updates and news, and don't miss the opportunity to be among the first to discover this explosive world!

So, get ready for adventures, bold choices, and boundless pleasure. "Sex of Thrones" is ready to redefine your perception of adult visual novels. A game that deserves your attention! 🔥🕹😉
